excluded_pure_like_or_capability_calls.reason: Mutates a live derived due index and its record map.
Consumes due entries from a live dispatcher.
Calls std::thread::available_parallelism; result depends on current process/host resources.
Constructs a view holding references to live DreamFreshnessJournal and ProcessingEpochStore.
Opens and reads the named physical file.
No store/callback, but returns HashSet iteration as Vec; output order depends on randomized hash state, so not an exact stable value contract.
Deterministic policy body, but public generic IntoIterator permits caller-defined IntoIterator/Iterator::next callbacks; no blanket callee exemption without a monomorphized concrete-input proof.

no_exception_scope: No blanket component-pair permission. Any later compiler contract should name exact callee definitions and require source/body hashes plus the listed transitive proof; candidates remain subject to root review and current-source refresh.
